title: Subtractive Brutalism & Raw Materiality
discipline: Neo-Brutalism · Digital Honesty · Truth-to-Screen Materials · Anti-Corporate Minimalism
hypothesis: Can digital brutalism transcend superficial kitsch by formulating an uncompromising philosophy of 'digital honesty'—stripping away fake skeumorphic lighting, corporate pastels, and blurred shadows in favor of hard zero-blur geometry, monospaced typography, and structural truth-to-materials?
